notes: New Health check (Mnara 2.0): battery, disk health and free space, heat, memory pressure, crashes and freezes, startup items.
Each check shows the macOS value behind it.
Alerts when a check gets worse, each with what was measured and one clear next step.
"Get help from Apple" appears only for hardware problems, and can be turned off in Settings.
Explain my Mac now covers the Health check and only uses measured values.
Checks that can't read their data stay hidden instead of showing wrong values.
The upgrade banner can be closed with ×; the upgrade stays in Settings → License.
